title: Wholesome Tofu and Broccolini Stir-Fry
subtitle: with Grains and Roasted Peanuts
description: Delicious and nutritious, this stir-fry offers the best of both worlds. Think honey soy tofu for protein, a medley of Asian veg and a nutty blend of wholegrains.

steps.text: Cook grain blend: Fill a medium saucepan three-quarters full with water and bring to the boil. Add the grain blend and cook for 20-22 mins until tender. Drain.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, peel the carrot, halve lengthwise, then thinly slice on an angle. Coarsely chop the pak choy. Halve the broccolini lengthwise, then halve widthwise. Coarsely chop the peanuts. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Combine 1 tsp sesame oil , 1 tbs soy sauce, 1 tsp honey and 1 tbs water in a bowl.

Warm tofu: Quarter the tofu pieces on an angle (see Make it yours). Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the tofu for 1-2 mins each side until golden and warmed through. Remove from the pan.

Stir-fry veggies: Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in the same pan over medium-high heat. Stir-fry the broccolini stems, carrot and garlic for 3 mins or until almost tender. Add the pak choy stems and broccolini florets and cook for a further 3 mins or until tender but still with crunch.

Serve up: Add the pak choy leaves and sauce mixture to the veggies and stir-fry for 1-2 mins until combined and warmed through. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Remove the pan from the heat. Divide the grain blend, stir-fry and tofu among plates, scatter over the peanuts and enjoy!
Make it yours: We've cut the tofu into quarters, but feel free to thinly slice instead. Simply stir-fry to warm through.
